text.tspan: No BFD on Connect: a dead node is detected by the BGP hold timer (≤ 30 s),
unless its health checker withdraws the route first (04).
Each Connect peer carries two BGP sessions for redundancy.
Not chosen: B VPC Route Server (VPC-only, no ECMP) ·
C Site-to-Site VPN per node · D no anycast in AWS
